name: 荷兰高技术移民居留许可
summary: 面向与荷兰雇主或研究机构签约、由 IND 认可担保人申请并达到收入要求的高技术人才。
summaryEn: For highly skilled workers contracted by a Dutch employer or research institution whose IND-recognised sponsor applies and who meet the income rules.

jobOffer.summary: 须与位于荷兰的雇主或研究机构订立雇佣合同。
jobOffer.summaryEn: An employment contract with an employer or research institution in the Netherlands is required.

sponsorship.summary: 仅 IND 认可担保人可为该许可提出申请。
sponsorship.summaryEn: Only a sponsor recognised by the IND can apply for this permit.

salary.summary: 收入须达到申请时适用标准，且约定工资须符合市场水平。
salary.summaryEn: Income must meet the amount applicable at the time of application and the agreed salary must be market-rate.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
